meta.title: Visual Design Pass — DevTools-native
meta.direction: DevTools-native: #0d1117 ground, blue-biased neutrals, single blue accent (#58a6ff), semantic severity ramp, mono for metrics, dense/functional, flat compact nav — feels like part of Chrome/React DevTools.
meta.process: Per story: build → headless screenshot → maintainer reviews the image → iterate. Visual quality is the maintainer's verdict; structure/render/build are machine-verified.
notes: Reuse the existing token file; refine, don't reinvent. No new palette invented — stay in the chosen direction.
Autonomously buildable (CSS/components + RTL + build); the LOOK is human-reviewed via screenshots.

stories.title: Design language + shell polish
acceptanceCriteria: tokens.css: confirm blue-biased neutral ramp + single accent + severity ramp + 8pt spacing + type scale; add any missing steps.
5-view nav: active-state indicator (underline/bar), per-view count badge (sum of child issue counts), hover; sub-tab strip restyled as a segmented control (not raw tab CSS).
sticky header; content padding rhythm; tabular-nums on metrics.
npm run build exit 0; Panel.test still green; headless screenshot produced for review.

stories.title: Dashboard view (real KPIs)
acceptanceCriteria: Severity stat-tile row + React version/mode chip + render sparkline + top-offender; card-based; RTL + screenshot.

stories.title: Card-based issue system
acceptanceCriteria: IssueCard on tokens: severity stripe+badge, collapsed/expanded hierarchy, empty states with guidance; RTL + screenshot.

stories.title: Profiler/State/Effects layouts
acceptanceCriteria: Profiler segmented chart canvas (area+grid+endpoint); State merged inspector split; Effects grouped; RTL + screenshot.
stories.shipped: Chart-canvas: new reusable ChartCanvas (area/line/bars, faint grid, emphasized endpoint, empty/1-point/flat guards, tokens+tabular-nums). Wired into Profiler → Memory (used-heap area timeline, replacing the hand-rolled polyline) and Profiler → Performance (render-distribution bars). Timeline filter chips de-noised (grey 1px + faint category tint + colored dot). State inspector: the Redux sub-tab already IS a tree/inspector split (Action History + selected-action detail, recursive collapsible State Tree with search/expand/collapse/inline-edit, dispatch form) and is token-consistent — verified by screenshot, not rewritten (complex + untested). Effects already grouped by category. Verified: 456 unit tests + 9 headless visual baselines (added profiler-memory, profiler-performance, state-redux) + build 0 + 0 page errors.

stories.title: Motion + a11y + WCAG
acceptanceCriteria: View/card transitions + prefers-reduced-motion; focus-visible; keyboard nav; WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on the new palette.
stories.shipped: rdbgViewIn rise+fade on section switch (main keyed on activeTab) + issue-card body reveal; global prefers-reduced-motion catch-all; link focus-visible ring (buttons already had one); --text-muted #484f58→#7d8590 to clear WCAG AA 4.5:1 (was 2.28:1) on both grounds, verified by contrast computation.

stories.title: Visual regression baselines
acceptanceCriteria: Playwright per-view screenshot baselines (headless); documented run.
stories.shipped: Dedicated headless lane (playwright-visual.config.ts + test/visual/): 6 baselines (5 views + classic), deterministic dist-served render with stubbed chrome.*, npm run test:visual, documented in test/visual/README.md. Passes 6/6 against baselines.
